window.policy: today plus at most three days in advance, from the official slate

inputs.arenas: data/app/arena_coordinates.json (Wikipedia coordinates -- NOT an NBA source, flagged)

hca.policy: pinned: home-court is the measured home-win rate converted to points, not a fitted parameter

independent_cross_check.what: sum of the official standings' HOME splits over the 30 clubs, from nba.com/standings

hca.note: the CI95 on the rate spans roughly 45-58% at n=197, so a 3-point home edge that many models assume is not supported by what has actually been played

luck.policy: z-score of actual wins over Pythagenpat expected wins; |z| > 2 is outside the noise band and a strategy leaning on that team is refused publication

same_night_game_margins.what: correlation between the margins of two games played on the same date

same_night_game_totals.what: correlation between the total points of two games on one date

same_night_home_wins.what: correlation between the home-win indicators of two games on one date

correlations.note: measured on the verified log; a player-prop pair cannot be measured because per-player game logs exist for five team-games only -- those cells are blank and flagged, and no parlay of props is priced

strategies.name: Home team, at the pinned home-court value
strategies.signal: bet the home side whenever the pinned HCA is positive
strategies.universe: every game in the verified log
strategies.why_not: out-of-sample log loss 0.704801 beats a coin flip by -0.01165, below the 0.002 floor the pre-registration sets

strategies.name: Walk-forward log margin
strategies.signal: bet the side with the better prior margin-per-game, adjusted by pinned HCA
strategies.universe: 149 games with >=3 prior games for both clubs
strategies.why_not: out-of-sample log loss 1.120111 beats a coin flip by -0.42696, below the 0.002 floor the pre-registration sets

strategies.name: Trade only when the estimators agree
strategies.signal: publish only games where E1 and E2 agree on the sign of the margin
strategies.universe: the live window; no point-in-time aggregate history exists
strategies.why_not: the season team-stat pages are stored as one snapshot taken on 2026-11-16, so any backtest of an aggregate-based signal would be looking at data from after the game it is testing. Refused rather than flattered.

strategies.name: Vacated-minutes advantage
strategies.signal: bet the side whose opponent loses more measured minutes to Out/Doubtful players
strategies.universe: games with a captured game book on both sides and a filed report
strategies.why_not: player logs exist for 5 team-games (the 2026-11-14 books) plus the 2026-11-15 finals; the two-sided sample is 0 games, so the signal has no history at all

strategies.name: Rest and travel
strategies.signal: bet the fresher side when rest differs by >=2 days, or the side that did not travel
strategies.why_not: rest is computable for the 197 captured games, but the arena-coordinate table is not an NBA source and two arenas have no coordinates, so the travel arm cannot be evaluated without the flagged cells

strategies.name: Same-night two-leg parlay, priced with measured rho
strategies.signal: combine two legs only when the rho-adjusted price beats both naive prices
strategies.universe: pairs of games on one date
strategies.why_not: measured rho is inside its own noise band, so the correlation adjustment does not earn its place yet -- the parlay is priced with it anyway, and the naive product is printed beside it, as required

strategies.name: Player-prop combination
strategies.signal: combine a player's points line with his team's total
strategies.why_not: no per-player prop line is published by an official source in this repository and the player-player correlation is unmeasured; a price here would be invented

leaderboard.name: Home team, at the pinned home-court value
leaderboard.signal: bet the home side whenever the pinned HCA is positive
leaderboard.universe: every game in the verified log
leaderboard.why_not: out-of-sample log loss 0.704801 beats a coin flip by -0.01165, below the 0.002 floor the pre-registration sets

leaderboard.name: Walk-forward log margin
leaderboard.signal: bet the side with the better prior margin-per-game, adjusted by pinned HCA
leaderboard.universe: 149 games with >=3 prior games for both clubs
leaderboard.why_not: out-of-sample log loss 1.120111 beats a coin flip by -0.42696, below the 0.002 floor the pre-registration sets

leaderboard.name: Trade only when the estimators agree
leaderboard.signal: publish only games where E1 and E2 agree on the sign of the margin
leaderboard.universe: the live window; no point-in-time aggregate history exists
leaderboard.why_not: the season team-stat pages are stored as one snapshot taken on 2026-11-16, so any backtest of an aggregate-based signal would be looking at data from after the game it is testing. Refused rather than flattered.

leaderboard.name: Vacated-minutes advantage
leaderboard.signal: bet the side whose opponent loses more measured minutes to Out/Doubtful players
leaderboard.universe: games with a captured game book on both sides and a filed report
leaderboard.why_not: player logs exist for 5 team-games (the 2026-11-14 books) plus the 2026-11-15 finals; the two-sided sample is 0 games, so the signal has no history at all

leaderboard.name: Rest and travel
leaderboard.signal: bet the fresher side when rest differs by >=2 days, or the side that did not travel
leaderboard.why_not: rest is computable for the 197 captured games, but the arena-coordinate table is not an NBA source and two arenas have no coordinates, so the travel arm cannot be evaluated without the flagged cells

leaderboard.name: Same-night two-leg parlay, priced with measured rho
leaderboard.signal: combine two legs only when the rho-adjusted price beats both naive prices
leaderboard.universe: pairs of games on one date
leaderboard.why_not: measured rho is inside its own noise band, so the correlation adjustment does not earn its place yet -- the parlay is priced with it anyway, and the naive product is printed beside it, as required

leaderboard.name: Player-prop combination
leaderboard.signal: combine a player's points line with his team's total
leaderboard.why_not: no per-player prop line is published by an official source in this repository and the player-player correlation is unmeasured; a price here would be invented
